description: This file defines the XValue class within the PdfSharp.Charting namespace, representing a value on the XSeries in a charting context. It includes a constructor, a clone method, and an internal string field for the value.

classes.name: XValue
classes.description: Represents the actual value on the XSeries in a chart, with methods to initialize and clone the object.

methods.name: XValue(string value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the XValue with a specified string value, throwing an exception if the value is null.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XValue instance.
